correctness.rationale: In A=F_q[x,y]/(xy,x^a-y^b), powers split across the two branch tails, and their principal ideals have a four-case exact dimension formula. Simultaneous terminal powers cancel precisely at u^k+v^k=0. Second differences of the proven image ranks determine every Jordan block count. Valuation and coefficient counts sum to q^(a+b-1), covering all radical elements. An independent multiplication-matrix and Gaussian-elimination checker exhaustively verified thirteen finite-field/dimension configurations, including extension fields, but the infinite theorem is from algebraic proof, not extrapolation. The only numerical precondition is q a prime power and a,b>=2.

value.rationale: The Jordan partition of multiplication by a radical element is a natural invariant refining Lefschetz behavior. The complete point-count polynomial over an unbounded two-branch family includes all nonlinear coefficients, distinguishes socle-gluing from a tensor-product complete intersection, and detects an exact arithmetic field-dependent phase transition in the balanced case. The compact two-valuation formula computes all counts without enumerating q^(a+b-1) elements, which is useful for testing structural Jordan-stratum predictions.
